lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-luminance maxima are arranged in a multi-tier horizontal grid across the mid-lateral flank. Blobs are roughly equidistant along the horizontal axis, forming vertices of rectangular subunits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, creating intersection nodes with the lateral blobs, defining a distinct checkerboard structure on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular linear feature is visible running longitudinally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity drop-off on the ventral side of the ridge creating a light-to-shadow gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white, angular scar resembling a checkmark or inverted V-shape is located on the upper lateral flank, dorsal to the mid-section and posterior to the gill region.
